name: Dolphin 2.9 Llama3 8B
notes: Architecture is Meta-Llama-3-8B's exactly (hidden 4096, 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, rope_theta 500000) with vocab padded to 128258. The one serving-relevant difference from every other 8B here is context: max_position_embeddings 8192, i.e. this is a short-context model and its KV budget at native length is trivial. No rope_scaling in config, so going beyond 8k is not a config claim. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128; gqa_ratio = 4.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 131072 B/token = 128.0 KiB/token. At its native 8k context that is 1.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16.
